platform: CJSF 90.1 FM National Music Director Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CJSF expressly invites music submissions through its National Music Director form and publishes cjsfmusc@sfu.ca for music delivery. A human must reopen the official page, inspect the live form and broadcast-rights acknowledgement without bypassing controls, confirm that a Netherlands-based MarcsMusic EP or album is eligible, verify the requested upload/attachment/link method, formats, file sizes, metadata, artwork, release timing, identity labels, explicit-content handling and AI-origin policy, and use either the form or mailbox once. CJSF does not accept singles into its local library and does not accept non-local physical submissions. The separately promoted !earshot Distro route is paid, account-gated and currently described as available to the Canadian music industry; do not use it without separate eligibility and payment approval.
